# Bundled 7-Zip

Unmodified Windows x64 console binaries, version 26.03, Copyright (C) 1999-2026
Igor Pavlov. The launcher embeds these files and extracts them into its own worker
directory, together with License.txt. A separate 7-Zip installation is not needed.

Upstream and corresponding source: https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/tree/26.03
Official downloads/source archives: https://www.7-zip.org/download.html
License information: see License.txt (LGPL, BSD and unRAR terms).

SHA-256 of the unmodified distribution binaries:

- 7z.exe: 6ee3c0ed0b27663c1b948ae85a7c0bb073aed1498983182f3f0df1f6a8c30b2f
- 7z.dll: 65e4c1f855f9ef6e8f0f5df8e3f27d9eb5f07311408639da0a1ca0b8f4871b0d

These binaries are part of the launcher distribution, not downloaded from the
resource archive. The resource downloader never executes downloaded SDK files.
